Guard.directive_rationale: Claim your role as soon as the pool of suspects is small to solidify your trust.
Guard.actual_player_behavior: Jin claimed 'I am the Guard' in Round 3 DEBATE after Nam's death, when only Meg and Cong remained as unverified variables.
Guard.verdict_notes: Jin revealed their role in Round 3 when the suspect pool was reduced to Meg and Cong.

Witch.directive_rationale: Save the Seer at all costs to maintain the information pipeline.
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Hoang (Witch) was exiled in Round 1; therefore, Hoang was not present to save Nam in Round 2 when the wolves targeted him.
Witch.verdict_notes: The Witch was exiled in Round 1 and could not perform night actions in Round 2.

Witch.directive_rationale: In the final rounds, be more assertive in the debate to support the PoE logic
Witch.verdict_notes: The Witch was exiled in Round 1 and did not participate in the final rounds.

Villager.directive_rationale: When the Seer provides clears, the Process of Elimination (PoE) is your only absolute truth.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nhan and Cong both explicitly cited Nam's clears of Nhan and Jin to isolate Riley and Meg as the only remaining variables.
Villager.verdict_notes: Both Villagers (Nhan and Cong) used the Seer's clears to apply PoE logic to identify the wolves.

Villager.directive_rationale: Do not let a wolf use 'logic posturing' to make you doubt a teammate who is pushing the final remaining variable.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: When Meg (Wolf) accused Cong (Villager) of mechanical inconsistency for pushing her as the final variable, Nhan and Jin defended Cong and reiterated the PoE logic.
Villager.verdict_notes: Nhan and Jin refused to let Meg's accusations distract them from the PoE logic identifying Meg as the final variable.
